title: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Examination 2026 Apply Online for 134 Post
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
vacancyDetails: 134 Junior Engineer Agriculture posts: UR 54, EWS 13, OBC 43, SC 23, ST 1.
qualification: UPSSSC PET 2025 score card, High School passed from a recognized board and 3-year Diploma in Agricultural Engineering from a recognized board or institute.
ageLimit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 40 years as on 01/07/2026. Age relaxation as per UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture recruitment rules.
applicationFee: General / UR / OBC / EWS: 25/-. SC / ST: 25/-. PH (Divyang): 25/-. Pay through UPI, debit card, credit card or net banking.
selectionProcess: PET 2025 shortlisting -> Main examination -> Document verification and final selection as per UPSSSC rules
documentsRequired: PET 2025 score card, educational certificates, identity proof, photograph, signature, category certificate and other required documents.
howToApply:
1. Visit the UPSSSC official website and read Advt. No. 19-Exam/2026.
2. Confirm PET 2025 eligibility and complete the online application.
3. Upload the required documents and pay the examination fee.
4. Check the preview carefully and submit the form.
5. Save or print the final submitted application.
shortDescription: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Agriculture Mains Examination 2026 recruitment for 134 posts. Apply online from 17 September 2026 to 07 October 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the notification for Junior Engineer Agriculture Main Examination 2026 under Advt. No. 19-Exam/2026.

Eligible candidates with a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 score card can apply online from 17/09/2026 to 07/10/2026 for 134 posts.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 17/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 07/10/2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 07/10/2026
  • Form Correction Last Date: 14/10/2026
  • Main Examination: As per Schedule
  • Exam City and Admit Card: Before Exam

Vacancy Details

  • UR: 54
  • EWS: 13
  • OBC: 43
  • SC: 23
  • ST: 1
  • Total: 134
